payload.statement: Figure 3C aligns YASSAVTFPGIK for zebrafish (wt), medaka, chicken and human and YASSAVKFPGIK for nr21 (T200K); Figure 2D labels residues 319 to 333 and aligns QSFMRSIFSPIFMLS for zebrafish, with F326 replaced by L in flying fishes. The supplement's Figure S2 legend places the nr21 mapping on chromosome 15 between 17 and 33 Mb, reports 0 recombinants among 145 chromosomes for the lat4a T200K SNP, and names a CRISPR frameshift allele L74Rfs6.
payload.title: Source statement (Figures 3C and 2D, Figure S2 legend): the paper's Lat4a sequence windows around T200 and F326, and the nr21 mapping interval

assumptions: The Ensembl sequences are the sequences of the genes named.
payload.context: [species: Danio rerio; evidence_class: source_assessment; source: Daane 2021 figures + supplement + Ensembl REST] Comparison and control in lat4a_residues_v1.json.
limitations: The windows are 12 and 15 residues of a highly conserved region, so this supports the paper's protein being slc43a2a and not slc43a2b; it does not test anything beyond that.
The figure windows were read by eye.
The transcript the authors numbered is not stated; the two isoforms agree at every position used.
Nothing here says what T200K or F326L does.

payload.statement: Both Ensembl slc43a2a proteins (ENSDARP00000120945, 571 aa; ENSDARP00000138218, 577 aa) contain the Figure 3C window at residues 194-205, so T is residue 200, and the Figure 2D window at 319-333, so F is residue 326; residues 74 and 106 are L, as the L74Rfs6 and L106Rfs39 alleles name. None of the four slc43a2b proteins (592-598 aa) contains either window (M200, D326, G106). The slc43a2a gene lies at 28.37-28.41 Mb on chromosome 15, inside the Figure S2 interval. The 153-aa RefSeq NP_956545.1 is identical to Ensembl 1-139 and then diverges: a short isoform, not a numbering conflict.
payload.title: Derived: Ensembl's full-length zebrafish slc43a2a carries the paper's windows at the paper's numbering, and slc43a2b does not
